params.prompt: Cinematic miniature diorama, heroic armored-tech workshop aesthetic: glossy hot-rod red and gold metal plating with crisp panel lines and rivets, brushed gunmetal accents, warm tungsten garage lighting, subtle cool reactor-glow highlights, tilt-shift miniature photography look, isometric three-quarter aerial view, ultra detailed, empty, unoccupied, no people, architectural model quality. On a plain solid deep warm charcoal background with a soft contact shadow. Palette: hot-rod red #B91C1C, gold #D4A017, gunmetal #3F3F46, amber core glow, warm white #FAF7F0. No text, no letters, no logos, centered composition. IMPORTANT: any armor design must be an entirely original invented design, NOT resembling Iron Man or any Marvel or famous superhero. Subject: a command deck mission control — tiered rows of consoles facing a large central holographic map table showing a miniature city of glowing districts, red and gold panel walls decorated only with a large hexagon emblem relief, a wide observation window band.
